limits: Documented stages rest on named inspected leaves of originals (Auxerre, Autun, Évreux colophons and calendars) or on exact-locus scholarship (Dubarat 1891, Du Lac 1849); none is transcribed or collated and no transition is claimed. Provisional stages rest on one-line scholarly statements (mostly L'épiscopat français 1907) of Roman restorations or changes of books; they record dated adoptions without the acts. Tesseract OCR (Afrikaans model) and provider OCR were used only to locate pages; every cited reading was checked on the image. Gallica, HathiTrust and BVMM refused or timed out, so gap rows are access-bounded, not evidence of absence. Two undated originals (Auxerre) remain unpositioned rather than taking catalogue years.
